description.value:
You direct a resonant pulse of sound at a target within range, who must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 sonic damage.

At higher levels the pulse can arc to strike additional targets in sequence: two targets at 5th level, three at 11th level, and four at 17th level. Each successive target must be within 30 feet of the last one struck, the final target no more than 30 feet from you, and you cannot strike the same creature twice in a row.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
